key: LIN: so! you've managed to find my SECRET LAIR.
en: LIN: so! you've managed to find my SECRET LAIR.
ja: リン: さて! よくもあたしの「秘密のアジト」を見つけたもんだね。

key: i bet y'all are feeling pretty good about yourselves, huh?
en: i bet y'all are feeling pretty good about yourselves, huh?
ja: みんな、さぞかし自分たちのこと誇らしいんでしょ?

key: well that's about to end!
en: well that's about to end!
ja: でも、それもすぐ終わるよ!

key: i'm going to blow you and all of your friends out of........
en: i'm going to blow you and all of your friends out of........
ja: あんたと友達全員まとめて、吹き飛ばして……
……ふっとばして……

key: wait, where is everyone?
en: wait, where is everyone?
ja: あれ、待って、みんなどこ?

key: is this like the opposite of a surprise party?
en: is this like the opposite of a surprise party?
ja: これって、サプライズパーティーの逆みたいなもの?

key: LIN: you've kept me waiting all this time, but NOW we'll end things once and for.....
en: LIN: you've kept me waiting all this time, but NOW we'll end things once and for.....
ja: リン: ずっと待たせてくれたけど、今度こそ、これで全部終わ……

key: what, still just you?
en: what, still just you?
ja: え、まだあんただけ?

key: well... i'm sure everyone else is on their way!
en: well... i'm sure everyone else is on their way!
ja: まあ……きっと他のみんなも向かってるところだよ!

key: i'm the bad guy! they have to stop me!
en: i'm the bad guy! they have to stop me!
ja: あたしは悪役なんだから! みんなあたしを止めなきゃいけないんだよ!

key: right?
en: right?
ja: だよね?

key: LIN: ...it's just going to be you, huh.
en: LIN: ...it's just going to be you, huh.
ja: リン: ……結局、あんただけなんだね。

key: man.
en: man.
ja: やれやれ。

key: i had everything all set up for a whole big epic showdown!
en: i had everything all set up for a whole big epic showdown!
ja: 大きな、壮大な最終決戦のために、あたし全部用意してたのに!

key: the forces of friendship vs the big baddy bad!
en: the forces of friendship vs the big baddy bad!
ja: 友情の軍勢 対 大悪党!

key: remember??? it was supposed to be a big party????
en: remember??? it was supposed to be a big party????
ja: 覚えてる??? 大きなパーティーになるはずだったんだよ????

key: i even had refreshments ready!!!
en: i even had refreshments ready!!!
ja: 軽食まで用意してたのに!!!

key: LIN: just in case??
en: LIN: just in case??
ja: リン: 念のためにね??

key: they could drink up while i rattled through my whole monologue!
en: they could drink up while i rattled through my whole monologue!
ja: あたしが長々と独白してる間、みんなそれ飲みながら聞いてくれればよかったのに!

key: i was very proud of that monologue!!!
en: i was very proud of that monologue!!!
ja: あの独白、すごく自信あったんだから!!!

key: i spent all day working on it...
en: i spent all day working on it...
ja: 一日かけて考えたんだよ……

key: what, are they just too scared of me??
en: what, are they just too scared of me??
ja: 何、みんなあたしのことがそんなに怖いわけ??

key: can't face me themselves?
en: can't face me themselves?
ja: 自分たちだけじゃ、あたしに立ち向かえないの?

key: well......
en: well......
ja: まあ……

key: whatever.
en: whatever.
ja: まあいいや。

key: i guess you're still here.
en: i guess you're still here.
ja: あんたはまだいるみたいだけど。

key: c'mon, let's do our big showdown or whatever.
en: c'mon, let's do our big showdown or whatever.
ja: さあ、大きな最終決戦とやら、やろっか。

key: who even cares anymore.
en: who even cares anymore.
ja: もう、どうでもいいけどさ。

key: NOEL: \PN, should I pull you out?
en: NOEL: \PN, should I pull you out?
ja: ノエル: \PN、あなたを引き戻した方がいいですか?

key: NOEL: Okay, hold on.
en: NOEL: Okay, hold on.
ja: ノエル: わかりました、少し待ってください。

key: SIGMUND: I offer you, child, asylum.
en: SIGMUND: I offer you, child, asylum.
ja: シグムンド: 子供よ、私は君に、避難所を提供しよう。

key: Do not flinch from the name-- for what asylum is, is too oft misunderstood as mere containment.
en: Do not flinch from the name-- for what asylum is, is too oft misunderstood as mere containment.
ja: その言葉にひるむ必要はない――「避難所」というものは、単なる収容施設だと、あまりにも誤解されがちだからだ。

key: Down to its roots-- the Greek "asylon", meaning "refuge", that itself from "asylos"-- "a safe place, protecting those inside from violence and harm."
en: Down to its roots-- the Greek "asylon", meaning "refuge", that itself from "asylos"-- "a safe place, protecting those inside from violence and harm."
ja: 語源をたどれば――ギリシャ語の「アシュロン」、意味は「避難」。それはさらに「アシュロス」から来ている――「暴力や害から中にいる者を守る、安全な場所」。

key: Allow me to offer you what your parents could not.
en: Allow me to offer you what your parents could not.
ja: 君の両親が与えられなかったものを、私が与えよう。

key: No harm will come to you here, child.
en: No harm will come to you here, child.
ja: ここでは、君に危害が及ぶことはない、子供よ。

key: CHARLOTTE: Stuck in here again, huh?
en: CHARLOTTE: Stuck in here again, huh?
ja: シャルロット: また閉じ込められてるんだ?

key: What'd you do this time?
en: What'd you do this time?
ja: 今度は何やったの?

key: Have you considered, perhaps, NOT being an insufferable little nuisance for once in your life?
en: Have you considered, perhaps, NOT being an insufferable little nuisance for once in your life?
ja: 一生に一度くらい、耐えがたいほど迷惑な存在にならないでいることを、考えたことある?

key: Didn't think so.
en: Didn't think so.
ja: まあ、ないよね。

key: We may both be in here for the night, but don't expect me to act all buddy-buddy to you.
en: We may both be in here for the night, but don't expect me to act all buddy-buddy to you.
ja: 今夜はあたしたち二人ともここにいるかもしれないけど、あたしがあんたに仲良くするなんて期待しないでよ。

key: Not after last time.
en: Not after last time.
ja: 前回の後じゃ、なおさら。

key: If you didn't want to lie in it, you shouldn't have dug your own grave.
en: If you didn't want to lie in it, you shouldn't have dug your own grave.
ja: 自分で墓穴を掘りたくなかったなら、最初から掘らなきゃよかったのに。

key: ANNA: Oh, hi, Lin!
en: ANNA: Oh, hi, Lin!
ja: アンナ: あ、こんにちは、リン!

key: You wanted to play another game?
en: You wanted to play another game?
ja: また別のゲームやりたいの?

key: Sure, but I'm obviously just gonna win again!
en: Sure, but I'm obviously just gonna win again!
ja: いいけど、どうせまたあたしが勝つに決まってるからね!

key: You don't use your pawns as much as you could, and then you have to rely on your queen too much.
en: You don't use your pawns as much as you could, and then you have to rely on your queen too much.
ja: ポーンをもっと使えるはずなのに使ってないから、クイーンに頼りすぎになっちゃうんだよ。

key: Here, you can move first.
en: Here, you can move first.
ja: はい、あなたが先に動いていいよ。

key: You could try to work on maintaining a more consistent line this game?
en: You could try to work on maintaining a more consistent line this game?
ja: 今回は、もっと一貫した陣形を保つように頑張ってみたら?

key: Fair warning-- even though I'm saying this now, don't expect me to go easy or help you once we start!
en: Fair warning-- even though I'm saying this now, don't expect me to go easy or help you once we start!
ja: 一応言っとくけど――今こう言ってても、始まったら手加減したり助けたりしないからね!

key: This one's gonna be all-out!
en: This one's gonna be all-out!
ja: 今度こそ全力でいくから!

key: NOEL: What do you want, Lin?
en: NOEL: What do you want, Lin?
ja: ノエル: 何が欲しいんですか、リン。

key: If you don't need anything from me, then just go away.
en: If you don't need anything from me, then just go away.
ja: 僕に用がないなら、あっちに行ってください。

key: I'm tired of all your stupid games.
en: I'm tired of all your stupid games.
ja: あなたのくだらないゲームには、もううんざりです。

key: So is everyone else.
en: So is everyone else.
ja: 他のみんなもそうです。

key: Even Anna is just too nice to say no.
en: Even Anna is just too nice to say no.
ja: アンナだって、優しすぎて「嫌」って言えないだけです。

key: Leave her alone for once.
en: Leave her alone for once.
ja: 一度くらい、彼女を放っておいてください。

key: LAURA: H-hello there, little Lin........
en: LAURA: H-hello there, little Lin........
ja: ローラ: こ、こんにちは、リンちゃん……

key: I'm, ah, very-- very sorry, but I can't-- er, won't be able to play with you right now........
en: I'm, ah, very-- very sorry, but I can't-- er, won't be able to play with you right now........
ja: その、あの、本当に――本当にごめんなさい、でも今は一緒に遊べ――えっと、遊べないの……

key: Please don't be upset!
en: Please don't be upset!
ja: 怒らないでね!

key: It's just that I-- my sisters, they had something they wanted to do........
en: It's just that I-- my sisters, they had something they wanted to do........
ja: ただ、その――妹たちが、何かやりたいことがあって……

key: It was meant to be just between the three of us as family, you know?
en: It was meant to be just between the three of us as family, you know?
ja: 家族三人だけの時間になるはずだったの、わかる?

key: Sorry-- maybe we can draw together more next time!
en: Sorry-- maybe we can draw together more next time!
ja: ごめんね――次はもっと一緒にお絵描きできるといいね!

key: SAPHIRA: For the last time,
en: SAPHIRA: For the last time,
ja: サファイラ: これで最後よ、

key: Back the fuck off.
en: Back the fuck off.
ja: いい加減、離れなさい。

key: She said she didn't want to play with you, so she's not going to play with you.
en: She said she didn't want to play with you, so she's not going to play with you.
ja: あの子はあんたと遊びたくないって言ったの、だからもう遊ばないから。

key: No matter how many times you ask, it's not going to change,
en: No matter how many times you ask, it's not going to change,
ja: 何回聞いたって、それは変わらないの。

key: So stop asking.
en: So stop asking.
ja: だから、もう聞くのはやめて。

key: None of us want to have this conversation ever again, and yet you show up insisting on the same thing day after day.
en: None of us want to have this conversation ever again, and yet you show up insisting on the same thing day after day.
ja: あたしたちの誰も、二度とこの話をしたくないのに、あんたは毎日毎日同じことを言いに来るのね。

key: Am I understood or am I not understood?
en: Am I understood or am I not understood?
ja: わかった? わからなかった?

key: Say it with me then.
en: Say it with me then.
ja: じゃあ、一緒に言ってみて。

key: You will leave her alone,
en: You will leave her alone,
ja: あなたはあの子に構わない、

key: Now and for forever.
en: Now and for forever.
ja: 今も、これから先もずっと。

key: JOHN: Lin, we can't keep doing this.
en: JOHN: Lin, we can't keep doing this.
ja: ジョン: リン、こんなことをいつまでも続けられないよ。

key: You get five more minutes with the lights on, but that's it.
en: You get five more minutes with the lights on, but that's it.
ja: あと五分だけ明かりをつけといてあげるけど、それだけだよ。

key: Any more, and I'm going to have to explain to the Doctor why you keep insisting I be the one to do your checks.
en: Any more, and I'm going to have to explain to the Doctor why you keep insisting I be the one to do your checks.
ja: これ以上だと、なんで君がいつも僕に見回りをさせたがるのか、ドクターに説明しなきゃいけなくなる。

key: Neither of us want that, so please, just,
en: Neither of us want that, so please, just,
ja: 二人ともそんなの望んでないだろうから、だから、

key: For once in your life,
en: For once in your life,
ja: 生きてる間に一度くらいは、

key: Be quiet, and go to sleep.
en: Be quiet, and go to sleep.
ja: 静かに、寝てくれ。

key: TERRA: H-hey, hold on, what's the matter?
en: TERRA: H-hey, hold on, what's the matter?
ja: テラ: ちょ、ちょっと待って、どうしたの?

key: Where are your parents?
en: Where are your parents?
ja: あんたの親はどこ?

key: Okay, no, no, I'm sorry-- please don't cry?
en: Okay, no, no, I'm sorry-- please don't cry?
ja: ああ、いや、違う、ごめん――泣かないで?

key: Look, don't you have anyone looking out for you?
en: Look, don't you have anyone looking out for you?
ja: ねえ、誰かあんたのこと見てくれてる人いないの?

key: I have to get home before my parents notice I've been out, but...
en: I have to get home before my parents notice I've been out, but...
ja: アタシも、親に外出してたのがバレる前に帰らなきゃなんだけど……

key: Well, if you just need somewhere to get out of the rain, you could come with me, I guess?
en: Well, if you just need somewhere to get out of the rain, you could come with me, I guess?
ja: まあ、雨をしのげる場所が必要なだけなら、一緒に来てもいいけど?

key: We're still in city limits, and then we can make some phone calls and figure out where you need to be, okay?
en: We're still in city limits, and then we can make some phone calls and figure out where you need to be, okay?
ja: まだ市内だし、電話して、あんたが行くべき場所を探せばいいよ、いい?

key: Oh, I can show you what games I have too!
en: Oh, I can show you what games I have too!
ja: あ、アタシが持ってるゲームも見せてあげる!

key: If-- if you like that kind of thing anyway.
en: If-- if you like that kind of thing anyway.
ja: まあ――そういうの好きならだけど。

key: It's gonna be all right... Don't worry...
en: It's gonna be all right... Don't worry...
ja: 大丈夫だから……心配しないで……

key: You know, maybe someday, the both of us can learn to stop living in fear.
en: You know, maybe someday, the both of us can learn to stop living in fear.
ja: ねえ、いつか二人とも、怖がって生きるのをやめられるようになるかもね。

key: Wouldn't that be something?
en: Wouldn't that be something?
ja: すごいことじゃない?

key: Look, I'm certainly not going to blame you for anything--
en: Look, I'm certainly not going to blame you for anything--
ja: ねえ、あなたを責めるつもりなんて全くないんだけど――

key: I just don't understand it, see?
en: I just don't understand it, see?
ja: ただ、わからないのよ。

key: Our little girl's been acting so strangely ever since you came here, and, of course you're not responsible for her actions, but...
en: Our little girl's been acting so strangely ever since you came here, and, of course you're not responsible for her actions, but...
ja: あなたが来てから、うちの娘の様子がずっとおかしくて、もちろんあなたのせいだなんて思ってないけど……

key: I just wonder if some space wouldn't do her good.
en: I just wonder if some space wouldn't do her good.
ja: 少し距離を置いた方が、あの子のためになるんじゃないかって思うのよ。

key: Proper boundaries and all that.
en: Proper boundaries and all that.
ja: きちんと境界線を引く、みたいなことね。

key: I don't think you've slept in the room we set up for you even once, have you?
en: I don't think you've slept in the room we set up for you even once, have you?
ja: あなたのために用意した部屋で、一度も寝たことないんじゃない?

key: Perhaps it's time we try a little harder to figure out just where you came from...
en: Perhaps it's time we try a little harder to figure out just where you came from...
ja: そろそろ、あなたがどこから来たのか、もう少し頑張って調べてみるべき時かもね……

key: Oh, honey, of course you can stay with us!
en: Oh, honey, of course you can stay with us!
ja: あら、もちろんうちに泊まっていいのよ!

key: At least long enough until we figure out your situation, yeah?
en: At least long enough until we figure out your situation, yeah?
ja: 少なくとも、あなたの事情がわかるまでは、ね?

key: A little girl, left alone out in the storm-- oh geez, what's the city coming to?
en: A little girl, left alone out in the storm-- oh geez, what's the city coming to?
ja: 小さな女の子が、嵐の中に一人きりで――ああもう、この街も一体どうなってるのかしら?

key: It seems like just anyone can do heartless things these days.
en: It seems like just anyone can do heartless things these days.
ja: 最近は、誰でも平気で冷たいことをするみたいね。

key: Well don't you worry about it, honey.
en: Well don't you worry about it, honey.
ja: まあ、あなたは心配しなくていいのよ。

key: We can set you up in the storeroom-- a little cramped, don't mind it! But it's all yours as long as you need.
en: We can set you up in the storeroom-- a little cramped, don't mind it! But it's all yours as long as you need.
ja: 物置部屋を用意してあげる――ちょっと狭いけど気にしないで! でも、必要な間はずっとあなたのものよ。

key: Speaking of, you need a towel and a half!
en: Speaking of, you need a towel and a half!
ja: そういえば、タオルが一枚半は必要そうね!

key: Bet you some cocoa will do you good before you catch a cold too.
en: Bet you some cocoa will do you good before you catch a cold too.
ja: 風邪引く前に、ココアでも飲むといいわ。

key: Marshmallows, honey?
en: Marshmallows, honey?
ja: マシュマロは、いる?

key: Shush-- shh, shh, sh...
en: Shush-- shh, shh, sh...
ja: しーっ――しー、しー、し……

key: No more, no more crying, he's gone now...
en: No more, no more crying, he's gone now...
ja: もう、もう泣かないで、あの人はもういなくなったから……

key: Your father won't hurt you or anyone else ever again...
en: Your father won't hurt you or anyone else ever again...
ja: お父さんは、もう二度とあなたも誰も傷つけない……

key: But it's too late, isn't it?
en: But it's too late, isn't it?
ja: でも、もう遅いのよね?

key: I'm so sorry-- I failed you.
en: I'm so sorry-- I failed you.
ja: ごめんなさい――あなたを守れなかった。

key: I failed you...
en: I failed you...
ja: あなたを、守れなかった……

key: This is the least I can do.
en: This is the least I can do.
ja: これがせめて、してあげられることなの。

key: You shouldn't have to live with the same pain-- this is for the best--
en: You shouldn't have to live with the same pain-- this is for the best--
ja: あなたが同じ痛みを抱えて生きなくていいように――これが一番いいのよ――

key: No, what am I doing?
en: No, what am I doing?
ja: いや、あたし、何をしてるの?

key: What am I doing?
en: What am I doing?
ja: 何をしてるの?

key: Mommy is so sorry, darling...
en: Mommy is so sorry, darling...
ja: ママは本当にごめんね、あなた……

key: I'm so sorry...
en: I'm so sorry...
ja: 本当にごめんなさい……

key: I'm sorry...
en: I'm sorry...
ja: ごめんなさい……

key: You did good, little girl.
en: You did good, little girl.
ja: よくやったわね、小さな子。

key: You'll always be my little angel.
en: You'll always be my little angel.
ja: あなたはずっと、あたしの小さな天使よ。

key: Remember, not a word to mommy-- for her sake.
en: Remember, not a word to mommy-- for her sake.
ja: 覚えておいて、ママには何も言わないこと――あの子のためにね。

key: But I'm sure that someday, for some very lucky man, you'll be just a perfect wife.
en: But I'm sure that someday, for some very lucky man, you'll be just a perfect wife.
ja: でもきっといつか、すごく運のいい男の人にとって、あなたは完璧な妻になるわ。

key: ...Take some refreshments?
en: ...Take some refreshments?
ja: ……軽食、いかが?

key: LIN: okay this was DEFINITELY supposed to be root beer, not honey.
en: LIN: okay this was DEFINITELY supposed to be root beer, not honey.
ja: リン: ちょっと、これは絶対ルートビアのはずだったのに、蜂蜜じゃん。

key: what even is the point of just putting honey out???
en: what even is the point of just putting honey out???
ja: 蜂蜜だけ出して、一体何の意味があるわけ???

key: what are people gonna do, drink it?
en: what are people gonna do, drink it?
ja: みんなどうすればいいの、飲むの?

key: it doesn't even come out of the bottle half the time.
en: it doesn't even come out of the bottle half the time.
ja: 半分くらいの確率で瓶からすら出てこないし。

key: god, this was going to be the worst party.
en: god, this was going to be the worst party.
ja: ああもう、最悪のパーティーになるところだった。

key: no wonder no one showed up.
en: no wonder no one showed up.
ja: 誰も来なかったのも当然か。

key: ...oh, right.
en: ...oh, right.
ja: ……ああ、そうだった。

key: no one showed up.
en: no one showed up.
ja: 誰も来なかったんだった。

key: haha.
en: haha.
ja: はは。

key: forgot about that for a minute.
en: forgot about that for a minute.
ja: 一瞬、忘れてた。

key: let's go back to that world.
en: let's go back to that world.
ja: あの世界に戻ろっか。

key: I don't know what's going on, so help me cope with this stress by buying something!
en: I don't know what's going on, so help me cope with this stress by buying something!
ja: 何が起きてるのかわからないけど、何か買ってストレス発散に協力してくれ!

key: MARCELLO: Ah, more customers?
en: MARCELLO: Ah, more customers?
ja: マルチェロ: ああ、また客か?

key: Perhaps this isn't such a bad spot.
en: Perhaps this isn't such a bad spot.
ja: 案外、悪くない場所なのかもしれんな。

key: Buy something!
en: Buy something!
ja: 何か買ってくれ!

key: LIN: ...sorry i yoinked you out here.
en: LIN: ...sorry i yoinked you out here.
ja: リン: ……ここに引っ張ってきちゃってごめんね。

key: i don't think you'll get many customers.
en: i don't think you'll get many customers.
ja: あんまり客は来ないと思うけど。
